evidence.t: Road: Groundhog Creek FSR, 5.3 km stretch.
100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
2 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
17 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

flags.t: Route enters a Motor Vehicle Closed Area: Thompson, Cariboo and Okanagan Alpines. Closed Year Round. Exemption: Snowmobiles exempt year round (January 1 to December 31). Synopsis map 1-82/24.
Spot is inside a Motor Vehicle for Hunting Closed Area: Groundhog Creek. Road Closure. Synopsis map 2-43/24.
Spot is inside an ATV (all terrain vehicle) for Hunting Closed Area: South Chilcotin and M.U. 5-14. Closed between 4:00 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. from September 1 to November 30. Synopsis map 4-2/23.

plan: Drive: from Chilanko Forks, about 113 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 51.41234, -123.49556, pull off on A20019 Cp982 (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk 5.2 km to the start. Walk: the Groundhog Creek FSR stretch, 5.3 km one way. About 106 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 5-4, Region 5. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-09-15, closures 2026-10-16.
